test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Devendra Fadnavis became the ________ of the state of Maharashtra on 30th June 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deputy Chief Minister**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Devendra Fadnavis was appointed as the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra on 30th June 2022.
 
• He had previously served as the Chief Minister of Maharashtra from 2014 to 2019.
 
• His appointment came after the political upheaval in Maharashtra leading to the formation of a new government.
 
• Fadnavis is a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He is known for his administrative acumen and experience in state politics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Minister of Maharashtra:**

 
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the state government in Maharashtra.
 
• The role involves overseeing the administration and executing state policies.
 
• Maharashtra has seen various political leaders holding the position since its formation in 1960.
 
 
 
• **Political Crisis in Maharashtra 2022:**
 
 
• The political crisis involved a split within the Shiv Sena party.
 
• The crisis led to the resignation of Uddhav Thackeray as Chief Minister.
 
• A new coalition government was formed with Eknath Shinde as the Chief Minister and Devendra Fadnavis as the Deputy Chief Minister.
 
 
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP):**
 
 
• The BJP is one of the two major political parties in India.
 
• It was founded in 1980 and has a significant presence across the country.
 
• The party follows the ideology of Hindutva and is known for its nationalist policies.
 
 
 
• **Role of Deputy Chief Minister:**
 
 
• The Deputy Chief Minister assists the Chief Minister in administrative duties.
 
• They may also take charge of specific departments or portfolios.
 
• The position is not mandatory and depends on the state's political structure and requirements.
